\textbf{Analysis.} Between the three rounds of one configuration the frame time varies by 0.3--10.1\,ms, so differences of a few milliseconds are not significant. The night configuration (searchlights, beams, lamps, intruders, both UAV cameras rendering) costs +3.43\,ms over day (11.90 to 15.33\,ms). The thermal view frame is -1.03\,ms shorter and draws 1.5\,M triangles against 4.1\,M in the visible view. Turning shadows off changes the day frame by +3.53\,ms, within that variation. Non-indexed drawing is the one large effect: +41.07\,ms (18.9\,fps), with non-indexed meshes every triangle stores its own three vertices instead of sharing them (a sphere: 3672 vertices instead of 614, Table~\ref{tab:prims}). Quality presets: LOW 12.62\,ms, HIGH 14.91\,ms, ULTRA 16.69\,ms, EPIC 11.90\,ms (ULTRA uses 8$\times$ MSAA, EPIC 4$\times$ plus TAA). In this headless setup much of a frame is CPU time: 4.41\,ms simulation and UAV camera submission plus 7.48\,ms rendering, of which 2.95\,ms is the UAV images' sensor model and CV (synchronous in the benchmark; on a worker thread in the game). Fastest: v1 look (no post) day at 85.5\,fps.
